messages:
Leila Khan: Kicked off VerdantHealth POC request — they want to swap from VerdantAPI to Redwood. Critical requirements: exact streaming contract (their SDK expects events named 'piece','ctx','finished'), identical token billing behavior, FHIR passthrough, EU processing only, BYOK HSM (PKCS#11), and a signed DPA. They asked for a 3-week evaluation. Who takes tech lead?
Marco Diaz: I can lead the engineering effort. Plan: build a Verdant-compatible proxy that preserves endpoint names, headers, and SSE event labels. Need a dump of their sample streaming frames + tokenization edgecase examples.
Hannah Yu: Sales asks: pricing parity + migration credit. Customer requested 60 days of cost parity. Proposal: 35% migration credit first 60 days and an engineering offset. Also need quota mapping (they currently enforce 75/min per API key).
Will Armstrong: I'll provision a small Dedicated eu-west slice and pin model rdx-3.0-small for the POC to meet latency targets. ops-bot: provisioning request queued.
sec-bot: Security summary: SOC2 Type II present. Private control plane supports EU-only processing. KMS options: AWS KMS, GCP CMEK; BYOK via PKCS#11 supported with ops addendum. DPA addendum required for 24mo immutable logs. Please provide DPO contact and completed questionnaire.
Marco Diaz: Streaming parity detail: Verdant streams three event types in order: 'piece' (token deltas), 'ctx' (periodic provenance/context frames every 40 tokens), 'finished'. Their client will drop responses if 'ctx' framing is missing or out-of-order. We'll mirror names and ordering exactly. Example test curl: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://poc.redwood.local/verdant/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>","stream":true}'```
Marco Diaz: SSE shim snippet: ```js
// map Redwood frames to Verdant-style events
if (rdx.delta) res.write('data: ' + JSON.stringify({piece: rdx.delta}) + "\\n\\n");
if (shouldEmitCtx) res.write('event: ctx\\n' + 'data: ' + JSON.stringify({prov: meta}) + "\\n\\n");
if (rdx.done) res.write('event: finished\\n' + 'data: {}' + "\\n\\n");
```
Hannah Yu: Evaluation metrics they requested: per-prompt token-cost delta, latency P95, clinical intent F1 on 500 labeled prompts, hallucination incidents, and tokenizer mismatch rate. They want <2% regression on critical intents.
Leila Khan: Legal flagged rollback + SLA concerns. We can propose canary routing (10% traffic for 72h) with automatic fallback to VerdantAPI if regression thresholds exceeded. Also need a POC SLA for availability during the test.
Will Armstrong: Tokenization note: Verdant uses a slightly different BPE which leads to token count diffs and truncation differences. Plan: run a token-diff across their 1.8k prompt corpus and instrument per-request token attribution during the POC. We'll also add a safe-truncate shim to avoid unintended truncation.
Marco Diaz: Action items for eng: 1) implement proxy endpoints and header passthrough (X-Customer, X-Request-ID), 2) SSE emulator with exact event sequencing ('piece','ctx','finished'), 3) mirror Verdant rate limits in the proxy, 4) token-diff tool + safe truncation, 5) smoke tests with ops.
ops-bot: Dedicated eu-west slice request created (ticket #73321). ETA ~48h.
sec-bot: Reminder: upload completed security questionnaire and DPO contact. We also need a short Private deployment diagram showing HSM placement for the DPA.
Hannah Yu: I'll draft pricing + migration credit language: 35% credit for first 60 days, engineering offset $10k, and a price-review at 60 days. Will post draft by EOD tomorrow.
Leila Khan: Timeline proposed: Week0 infra + proxy; Week1 streaming parity smoke & token diffs; Week2 evaluation runs & fixes; Week3 final report + contracting.
Will Armstrong: I'll have infra ready in ~48h for initial smoke and will coordinate with Marco for handshake tests.
Marco Diaz: Please share sample frames and tokenizer corpus ASAP so I can prototype SSE mapping and checksum generation for 'ctx' frames.
Leila Khan: I'll ask Verdant for the sample artifacts and legal contact. Scheduling kickoff demo for Wed 09:00 CET unless conflicts.
Hannah Yu: Confirmed. I'll bring pricing draft and migration credit details to the demo.
Marco Diaz: One more blocker to call out: their client expects an 'ctx' frame to include a SHA256 provenance hex over the last 512 bytes; we'll compute canonical bytes from Redwood outputs to match. Need to validate deterministic serialization.
sec-bot: We can compute canonical serialization but require the ops addendum for prov-id storage in audit logs.
Leila Khan: Great. Marking this thread as the POC single source of truth. I'll update with artifacts and Verdant contact when received.
